name: Visible Ores (all versions+) and netherite
summary: This mod allows you to see minerals in caves more clearly and makes netherite more visible in the Nether. Works very well with Optifine and works best with Complementary Shader.
body:
Hey everyone, thank you for installing this mod. I recommend using it with Optifine and/or complementary shaders. Thank you and enjoy! ;) leave a comment if u get any reviews :)


This ressourcepack allows you to see minerals in caves more clearly and makes netherite more visible in the Nether. Works very well with Optifine and works best with Complementary Shader.
